morning.title: Arrival at Kyoto Station & Eki Bento 🍱
morning.desc: Pick up IC transit card and savor seasonal bento breakfast.

morning.title: Check into Traditional Ryokan in Gion
morning.desc: Drop heavy bags, enjoy welcome roasted green tea and sweets.

afternoon.title: Kiyomizu-dera Wooden Stage & City Vista 🏯
afternoon.desc: Walk up Matsubara street, drink from Otowa spring fountain.

afternoon.title: Sannenzaka & Ninenzaka Traditional Lanes
afternoon.desc: Browse handcrafted ceramics, incense, and soft matcha soft-serve.

evening.title: Lantern-Lit Gion Geisha District Stroll 🏮
evening.desc: Spot lanterns reflected on cobblestones and wooden teahouses.

evening.title: Cozy Kaiseki Multi-Course Dinner
evening.desc: Tasting seasonal tofu, bamboo shoots, and Kyoto beef skewers.

morning.title: Early Morning Stroll in Arashiyama Bamboo Grove 🎋
morning.desc: Catch the golden hour breeze before tourist crowds arrive.

morning.title: Tenryu-ji Zen Garden & Dragon Ceiling 🐉
morning.desc: Meditate by the pond surrounded by pine trees and weeping cherry.

afternoon.title: Togetsukyo Bridge & Riverbank Bento Picnic 🍙
afternoon.desc: Riverside onigiri and iced hojicha tea watching wooden boats.

afternoon.title: Iwatayama Monkey Park Hike 🐒
afternoon.desc: Short scenic 20-min hike up the hill for panoramic views of Kyoto.

evening.title: Yudofu Hot-Pot Dinner at Sagano 🍲
evening.desc: Simmered silk tofu in kelp broth with ginger, scallions, and yuzu sauce.

evening.title: Foot Bath Cafe (Ashi-yu) Experience
evening.desc: Soak feet in hot mineral springs while sipping peach soda.

morning.title: Fushimi Inari-taisha Senbon Torii Hike ⛩️
morning.desc: Hike through 10,000 orange shrine gates winding through sacred mount Inari.

afternoon.title: Train ride to Uji (Matcha Capital) 🍵
afternoon.desc: Visit Byodoin Phoenix Hall featured on the 10-yen coin.

afternoon.title: Authentic Matcha Whisking Workshop
afternoon.desc: Learn ceremonial tea preparation with traditional wagashi confectionery.

evening.title: Pontocho Alley Izakaya Hop 🍢
evening.desc: Narrow lantern-lined alleyway beside Kamogawa river with grilled yakitori.

morning.title: Kinkaku-ji (The Golden Pavilion) ✨
morning.desc: Marvel at the gold-leaf Zen temple shimmering over Kyoko-chi mirror pond.

morning.title: Ryoan-ji Famous Rock Garden
morning.desc: Contemplate 15 mysterious stones arranged in raked white gravel.

afternoon.title: Nishiki Market Food Tasting 🦪
afternoon.desc: Known as Kyoto’s Kitchen: skewered octopus, tamagoyaki egg, sweet dango.

evening.title: Sunset along Kamogawa River Bank 🌅
evening.desc: Join locals sitting spaced out along the gentle river enjoying pastries.

morning.title: Ryokan Farewell Traditional Breakfast 🥣
morning.desc: Miso soup, grilled salmon, tamagoyaki, and pickled plum.

morning.title: Philosopher’s Path Souvenir Shopping 🛍️
morning.desc: Pick up chirimen cloth coin purses, washi tape, and yatsuhashi cookies.

afternoon.title: Haruka Hello Kitty Express to Kansai Airport ✈️
afternoon.desc: Cute themed scenic train ride directly to airport terminal.

evening.title: Airport Lounge & Scrapbook Journaling ✍️
evening.desc: Paste all train stubs and ticket receipts into TravelMate journal!
